messages.text:
"Create a complete, playable 2D top-down arcade delivery game called \"NEON COURIER\".

GAME CONCEPT:
The game takes place in a futuristic cyberpunk city in the year 2097. The player is a night-shift motorcycle courier delivering packages across a neon-lit city.

VISUAL STYLE:

- Beautiful pixel art graphics.
- Dark futuristic city environment.
- Neon purple, blue and pink lighting.
- Rainy streets with reflections.
- Animated traffic, street lights and signs.
- Smooth character and motorcycle animations.
- Atmospheric electronic background music.

GAMEPLAY:

- The player controls a motorcycle from a top-down perspective.
- Add responsive movement controls: WASD, arrow keys and mobile touchscreen buttons.
- Display a minimap showing the player, customers and delivery locations.
- Customers appear at different locations on the map.
- The player must collect packages and deliver them before the timer expires.
- Add traffic obstacles, road barriers and moving vehicles.
- Successful deliveries reward the player with coins.
- Consecutive deliveries create a combo multiplier.
- Make each level progressively more challenging.

PROGRESSION:

- Create at least 5 playable levels.
- Each level introduces a larger map and more difficult delivery routes.
- Add a motorcycle upgrade shop.
- Allow players to upgrade speed, handling and delivery bonuses using earned coins.
- Save player progress and purchased upgrades.

USER INTERFACE:

- Create a beautiful animated main menu.
- Include PLAY, GARAGE, SETTINGS and CREDITS buttons.
- Display coins, timer, current mission and delivery count during gameplay.
- Add a pause menu and game-over screen.
- Add a level completion screen with rewards and statistics.
- Use Turkish language for all menus and interface text.

SOUND:

- Add futuristic electronic background music.
- Add engine sounds, delivery sounds and button effects.
- Include volume controls in settings.

IMPORTANT:

- Make the game fully playable, not just a visual mockup.
- All buttons and menus must work.
- Implement actual collision detection, scoring, timers and delivery mechanics.
- Make controls responsive and gameplay smooth.
- Optimize for Android mobile screens.
- Use a polished, professional game interface.
- Do not leave placeholder graphics or unfinished mechanics.

The final result should feel like a small but polished indie arcade game.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Turkish-language 2D top-down cyberpunk motorcycle delivery game called “NEON COURIER,” optimized for mobile.

## Requirements
- Pixel-art neon city, rainy atmosphere, animated traffic and signs, electronic audio with volume controls.
- WASD/arrows/mobile controls, minimap, timed pickup-and-delivery missions, collisions, coins, combo scoring, and five progressively harder levels.
- Garage upgrades with persistent progress; Turkish menus and gameplay UI; working main menu, pause, settings, credits, and result screens.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game with inline CSS/JavaScript and localStorage persistence.
- Audio is generated with Web Audio oscillators; no external game assets are required.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with canvas rendering, responsive UI, five levels, driving/collision mechanics, delivery missions, traffic/barriers, upgrades, save data, menus, pause/results, controls, and generated audio.
- Ran `node --check` on the extracted JavaScript successfully.
- Browser-smoke-tested menu, starting a level, pausing/resuming/quitting, and opening the garage; no page errors observed.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/neon-latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Final review of gameplay and polish; a recent change made `W`/`H` mutable in preparation for responsive canvas sizing, but responsive canvas behavior still needs implementation/verification.

### Blocked
- Browser capture via `playwright-cli` failed because its expected Chromium installation was absent; testing succeeded using `/usr/bin/chromium` directly.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and finish responsive canvas dimensions/scaling; verify gameplay remains playable on mobile and desktop.
2. Test mission delivery, collision, timer/game-over, level completion, upgrade purchase and persistence, and settings controls in-browser.
3. Review git diff and report reasonable implementation assumptions and verification results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Browser screenshots are saved to `/tmp/opencode/neon-menu.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/neon-pause.jpg`, and latest `/tmp/opencode/neon-latest.jpg`; only the latest was inspected.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and polish the Turkish-language, mobile-friendly 2D arcade delivery game **NEON COURIER**.

## Requirements
- Neon rainy-city visuals, animated traffic, electronic audio with volume controls, keyboard and touchscreen controls, minimap, timed pickup-and-delivery missions, collisions, coins, combo scoring, and five increasingly difficult levels.
- Persistent garage upgrades and Turkish menus, gameplay UI, pause, settings, credits, and results.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` canvas game with inline CSS/JavaScript, localStorage saves, and Web Audio-generated sounds/music; no external game assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented core game features, menus, missions, traffic/barrier collisions, scoring, five levels, upgrades, persistence, settings, and responsive UI.
- Updated shell sizing and canvas backing dimensions to fit viewport changes; adapted menu-scene drawing to canvas dimensions.
- Fixed mobile touch controls being visible in the menu by toggling the `.hidden` class during gameplay/menu transitions.
- `node --check`/`new Function` JavaScript syntax validation passed.
- Browser-smoke-tested settings panel, garage upgrade purchase and persistence, level start, pause/resume/quit, and mobile/desktop viewport screenshots.

### Active
- Test delivery completion, collision behavior, timer/game-over, level completion, and touch controls in gameplay.
- Review final changes and polish remaining issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Browser-test mission pickup/delivery, collisions, timer/game-over, and level completion.
2. Verify touchscreen movement and settings changes in-browser.
3. Review `index.html` and report final verification; all repository files remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Local HTTP server was available at `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.
- Chromium screenshots: `/tmp/opencode/neon-responsive-mobile.png`, `/tmp/opencode/neon-responsive-desktop.png`.
- Browser CDP smoke test script: `/tmp/opencode/neon-cdp-test.cjs`.
- Repository status showed `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` as untracked.

- Verified pickup and delivery, coin rewards, collision detection, timeout/game-over, and level completion.
